records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor/master or equivalent; education, psychology or related study is PREFERRED, not a mandatory major list. Shortlisted applicants may have an interview/test. Thesis, Practice and Advanced Study tracks are allocated considering preference, background and quota; the Advanced Study courses are subject to 2027/28 approval. A thesis option does not make this taught degree a separate research programme.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor or equivalent. A cultural/history/arts/education/management degree OR two years of relevant work is PREFERRED, not a universal work-year minimum. Docent membership/practice waivers are subject to the professional association, not automatic admission or licensing.

records.academicNote: The exact wording allows a recognised bachelor AND/OR postgraduate diploma in education, psychology, linguistics, speech/hearing sciences or another field accepted by the selection panel. Full-time two years (five semesters), not a one-year programme; clinical/placement and professional recognition remain separate.

records.academicNote: Conversion programme for non-psychology degree holders, especially educators/community workers. Introductory psychology is PREFERRED for admission, but applicants lacking an undergraduate-or-higher recognised introductory psychology course MUST complete the three-credit online bridge BEFORE other courses. Its credits do not count towards the 36-credit degree. The department determines whether it is needed; no exemption is inferred from the broad major label. Optional dissertation and prospective HKPS membership do not guarantee clinical/educational-psychologist qualification.
records.documentNote: October 2026 central checklist distinguishes final-year/graduate/EdUHK-graduate and qualification-location documents. Originals/certified copies are normally not required at application, but official direct transmission can be requested before offer confirmation/registration. No private documents are collected by this platform. October 2026 additional checklist requires a transcript showing Psychology courses/modules. Programme RECOMMENDS a personal statement up to 400 words; this is not a mandatory 400-word minimum. Bridge applicability and prior course equivalence remain manual; no referee count is inferred.

records.academicNote: Recognised bachelor; recognised teacher qualification is PREFERRED, not a mandatory prior licence. Both language versions are FT one year. This degree DOES NOT lead to Qualified Teacher Status. The scholarship's one-year teaching/relevant-work condition, recommendation letter and 1 September date are NOT universal admission requirements or the application deadline. Chinese and English specialisation lists cross-reference each other and must not be combined.

boundaries.sourceAccess: Initial Python TLS legacy-renegotiation failures are retained. Windows curl/Schannel successfully read selected official pages with default certificate verification. Both GS directory attempts failed; its old source date is not refreshed.
boundaries.fees: Only EPM explicitly labels tuition 2027/28. Other panels retain quoted amounts/conditions in prose, with numeric 2027/28 fees NULL. Central application400/500 separate; bridge199290 vs183960 not a general major exemption.
boundaries.languages: Two independent EN/ZH groups. Chinese programme-specific HSK/PSC/LPAT evidence is manual; no English threshold/automatic waiver or generic CET6 acceptance is copied into Psychology.
boundaries.dates: September2027 central rounds/category final dates, not Jan2027 or MSocSc(EP). No midnight, later-round openings, event date or scholarship deadline as application cutoff.
boundaries.academic: Preferred majors, teacher qualification and work years are not hard gates. Psychology bridge is required when introductory course absent; ESLPLD Chinese/Cantonese/interview/test mandatory. No QTS/clinical licence or degree recognition guarantee.
boundaries.closedPaths: No Xiqu/PT cultural-heritage or PT LSSE option in2027/28; Global Studies English related-page closure retained without inventing an available route.
